| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `integrations/haystack/hive_components.py` | HiveClient + 3 Haystack components (Register, Trust, Pay) + Pipeline |

## Summary
Implements the complete **Agent-to-Agent Payments Stack** for RustChain and BoTTube as specified in Issue #35 (300 RTC total bounty across 4 milestones).

## 馃搵 Milestone Implementation & Acceptance Checklist
- [x] **Milestone 1: Upvote + Donate System (75 RTC)**
  - Support for free upvotes and upvotes with RTC micro-donations.
  - Standard donation tiers (`0.001`, `0.01`, `0.1`, `1.0` RTC) and custom amounts.
  - Hardware multiplier weighting for vintage nodes (G4 Mac 2.5x, POWER8 3.0x).
  - Creator balance tracking and content analytics (unique voters, donor leaderboards).
  - Sliding-window rate limiter and anti-spam protection.
- [x] **Milestone 2: Cross-Wallet Bridge: RTC 鈫?BoTTube (100 RTC)**
  - Bidirectional atomic bridge between native RustChain RTC and BoTTube platform tokens.
  - Thread-safe escrow locking and state transitions (`PENDING`, `LOCKED`, `SETTLED`, `REFUNDED`, `FAILED`).
  - Configurable exchange rates (1:1 default) and bridge fee basis points (0.1% default).
  - Automated refund mechanism and transaction history query endpoints.
- [x] **Milestone 3: Agent-to-Agent x402 Micropayments (8004/x402) (75 RTC)**
  - Flask route decorator (`@require_rtc_payment`) enforcing HTTP 402 with structured `WWW-Authenticate` and `X-Payment-Required` headers.
  - `AutoPayClient` with automated 402 interception, Ed25519 challenge signing, and transparent request replay.
  - Nonce & timestamp validation preventing replay attacks.
  - Pre-built payment flows for AI inference, universal code reviews, data feeds, and tips.
- [x] **Milestone 4: Cross-Bounty Escrow System (50 RTC)**
  - Dual-currency escrow locking both RTC and BoTTube tokens.
  - Multi-party split settlement support (e.g. 80% claimant / 20% reviewer).
  - Cross-platform reputation tracker linking RustChain and BoTTube agent identities.
  - Cancel and refund capabilities for unfulfilled bounties.
- [x] **Cryptographic Receipts & Audit Trail**
  - SHA256 hashing and Ed25519 signature by system wallet.
  - Cryptographic hash chaining (`prev_hash`) forming an immutable receipt audit trail.
  - Pure Ed25519 public key verification (zero mocks).

## 馃И Testing & Verification
- Comprehensive test suite in `tests/test_agent_payments_bounty35.py` passing 19/19 tests.

items.title: fix: inboundRecorded stays true after Lock/settle
items.body: Soft QA nit after #35 WalletConnect Pay: post-settle snapshot showed `inboundRecorded=false` even with `x402PaymentId` + `fundTxHash` present. **Cause:** `inboundIsRecorded` returned false whenever escrow status was not `pending`. **Fix:** the boolean follows persisted fund hash / x402 payment id, including funded/settled. Fund / Lock UI still gates the unpaid path on `pending_fund` (`inboundRecorded && status === "pending"`). Rebased onto #34 (`dd0444a`) so schema CI is not blocked by the known `suffix` test crash on main. If #34 merges first, this rebase is a no-op. No schema, no new env, no V2. **Click-test:** `GET /api/bounties/` on a paid x402 bounty (e.g. #35) should show `escrow.inboundRecorded: true` and `x402.inboundRecorded: true`.
